# Resource: tfe_sentinel_version

Manages Sentinel versions available on HCP Terraform and Terraform Enterprise.

-> **Note:** You can fetch a Sentinel version ID from the URL of an existing version in the HCP Terraform UI. The ID is in the format `tool-<RANDOM STRING>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Basic usage

resource "tfe_sentinel_version" "test" {
  version = "0.24.0-custom"
  url     = "https://tfe-host.com/path/to/sentinel.zip"
  sha     = "e75ac73deb69a6b3aa667cb0b8b731aee79e2904"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `version` (String) A semantic version string in N.N.N or N.N.N-bundleName format.

### Optional

- `archs` (Attributes Set) A list of architecture-specific binaries for this Sentinel version. When specifying architecture-specific binaries, the top-level `url` and `sha` attributes are deprecated and should not be used. If both top-level `url` and `sha` are specified, an `archs` entry for the `amd64` architecture must also be included, and its `url` and `sha` values must match the top-level values. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--archs))
- `beta` (Boolean) Whether or not this version of Sentinel is beta pre-release. Defaults to `false`.
- `deprecated` (Boolean) Whether or not this version of Sentinel is deprecated. Defaults to `false`.
- `deprecated_reason` (String) Additional context about why a version of Sentinel is deprecated. Defaults to `null` unless `deprecated` is `true`.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether or not this version of Sentinel is enabled for use in HCP Terraform and Terraform Enterprise. Defaults to `true`.
- `official` (Boolean) Whether or not this is an official release of Sentinel. Defaults to `false`.
- `sha` (String) The SHA-256 checksum of the compressed Sentinel binary. Soon to be deprecated, use `archs` instead.
- `url` (String) The URL where a ZIP-compressed 64-bit Linux binary of this version can be downloaded. Soon to be deprecated, use `archs` instead.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the Sentinel version.

<a id="nestedatt--archs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `archs`

Required:

- `arch` (String) The architecture for which this binary is intended.
- `os` (String) The operating system for which this binary is intended.
- `sha` (String) The SHA-256 checksum of the compressed binary.
- `url` (String) The URL where a ZIP-compressed binary of this version can be downloaded.




## Import

Resource tfe_sentinel_version can be imported in the following format: 

```shell
# via <SENTINEL VERSION ID>
terraform import tfe_sentinel_version.test tool-L4oe7rNwn7J4E5Yr

# via <SENTINEL VERSION NUMBER>
terraform import tfe_sentinel_version.test 0.24.0
```
